description: This file contains functions and classes for parsing and handling media codec information, including codec name retrieval, format verification, and detailed codec string parsing for formats like AV1, H264, H265, VP9, and VP09. It also includes operator overloads for printing media metadata and stream info.

classes.name: SbMediaMasteringMetadata
classes.description: Structure representing mastering display metadata including chromaticity and luminance.

classes.name: SbMediaColorMetadata
classes.description: Structure containing color metadata such as chromaticity coordinates, color primaries, transfer, matrix, range, and other color-related info.

classes.name: SbMediaVideoSampleInfo
classes.description: Structure with information about a video sample, including codec, resolution, MIME type, and key frame status.

classes.name: SbMediaAudioSampleInfo
classes.description: Structure with information about an audio sample, including codec, channels, sample rate, and specific configuration data.

classes.name: SbMediaVideoStreamInfo
classes.description: Structure with detailed video stream information, including codec, MIME type, resolution, and color metadata.

classes.name: SbMediaAudioStreamInfo
classes.description: Structure with detailed audio stream information, including codec, MIME type, channels, sample rate, and configuration.

methods.name: hex_to_int
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal character to its integer value.

methods.name: ReadOneDigitHex
methods.description: Reads a single hexadecimal digit from a string and outputs its value.

methods.name: ReadDecimalUntilDot
methods.description: Reads a decimal number from a string until a '.' or end of string.

methods.name: ReadTwoDigitDecimal
methods.description: Reads a two-digit decimal number from a string.

methods.name: VerifyFormat
methods.description: Verifies if a format string matches a reference pattern with wildcards.

methods.name: VerifyFormatStrictly
methods.description: Verifies if a format string exactly matches a reference pattern.

methods.name: ParseAv1Info
methods.description: Parses AV1 codec string to extract profile, level, bit depth, and color info.

methods.name: ParseH264Info
methods.description: Parses H264 codec string to extract profile and level.

methods.name: ParseH265Info
methods.description: Parses H265 codec string to extract profile and level.

methods.name: ParseVp09Info
methods.description: Parses VP9 codec string to extract profile and bit depth.

methods.name: ParseVp9Info
methods.description: Parses VP9 codec string to extract profile and bit depth.

methods.name: ParseVideoCodec
methods.description: Main function to parse a video codec string into its components and identify the codec type.
